thread:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — ClearBridge AI asked for a few config changes ahead of their LATAM demo next Thurs. Need to coordinate: temporary rate increase, LATAM egress region enable, and IP allowlist.
Devon Patel: Can you paste the exact numbers and CIDRs? Also flagging renewal touchpoint, they said demo outcome will affect Q4 renewal.
Maria Chen: Sure — traffic spike during demo expected ~2.5k rps for 45m. Requesting a per-minute burst to 150k tokens/min for the demo window. CIDRs: 54.210.0.0/16 and 3.120.80.0/20 (customer-managed legacy proxies). Region: enable southamerica-east1 (GCP) + route egress there.
Rahul Singh: Re: rate — do we have reserved capacity to cover 2.5k rps? If not, we can grant a temporary rate lift on hosted tier and add a soft cap alarm. I can also schedule a canary for the model variant.
Linh Tran: For region — infra needs a peering + egress route. NetOps will need customer ASN + VPN details. Also confirm whether they want traffic pinned to LA region or just lowest-latency routing.
NetOps Bot: @Maria Chen please open a support ticket with VPN + ASN + proof of ownership. Template: `ASN, public IPs, preferred peering window`
Maria Chen: I'll get the ticket opened. Customer says they want pinned routing to southamerica-east1 for demo to minimize latency.
Devon Patel: On renewal — I'll join the demo and run a short customer success + AE follow-up. We should capture perf metrics and errors during the window. Put an annotation in the console so we can pull per-route traces for the 45m window.
Rahul Singh: Action items for me: 1) create temporary rate-lift policy scoped to customer token for demo window (start/end + rollback), 2) create canary with model-quantized variant, 3) add prefix caching disabled for the window. Will document rollback steps.
Linh Tran: Action items for infra: 1) open peering request to enable southamerica-east1 egress 2) prepare a short-lived routing policy to pin requests to LATAM endpoints 3) whitelist the two CIDRs in edge ACL. ETA: 48hrs pending ticket.
Maria Chen: Customer requests the change to be in place by Tue 09:00 UTC to run rehearsals Wed. Is 48hrs feasible?
Rahul Singh: 48hrs is tight but doable if we get the VPN/ASN details in the next 2hrs. I'll prep the rate policy and tests now.
Devon Patel: I'll tell the customer to send VPN + ASN + contact. Also I'll book the demo slot on Wed so we can be on stand-by.
NetOps Bot: Deploy request received: `ticket #CS-9821` — awaiting customer VPN info.
Maria Chen: Quick config snippet the customer wanted to validate (they asked for our allowlist format):
```
{
  "customer": "ClearBridge AI",
  "allowlist": ["54.210.0.0/16","3.120.80.0/20"],
  "egress_region": "southamerica-east1",
  "temp_rate_token_limit": "150000 tokens/min",
  "window": "2026-04-08T09:00:00Z to 2026-04-08T09:45:00Z"
}
```
Rahul Singh: Looks good. I'll apply the rate policy as `cs-temp-burst/clearbridge/1987654321` and stamp the console annotation.
Linh Tran: Once peering is approved we'll run a smoke test: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood-inference/southamerica-east1/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'`
Devon Patel: Thx team. Also logging a soft renewal risk — customer said if demo latency >200ms they may re-evaluate pricing. Let's prioritize low latency.
Maria Chen: Noted. I'll add a PS to the demo invite: AE + CS + Onboarding + Infra on call.
NetOps Bot: Reminder scheduled in 24hrs to check ticket progress.
Rahul Singh: I'll post a short checklist in the ticket when done: rate policy applied, canary results, console annotation.
Maria Chen: Perfect — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
Devon Patel: I'll follow up after the rehearsal.
Rahul Singh: Update: rate policy staged, awaiting customer IP verification.
Linh Tran: Update: peering request submitted (PR-4487). Pending provider window.
NetOps Bot: Ticket #CS-9821 status changed to `pending-customer`
Maria Chen: Customer confirmed ASN + VPN via email, forwarded to ticket. ETA still looks OK for Tue window.
Devon Patel: Great job team. We'll capture perf and surface to execs if needed.
Maria Chen: Closing loop in here after rehearsal.
